note: Compositional Procurement Ontology. Four EXPLICIT levels: sector -> family -> category -> intent. Terms are three-tier (strong decides / weak+context decides / weak alone never decides) and inherit down the chain. Veto is declared at sector or family level and inherited; an intent only adds its own exceptions. FACETS carry all variation (dimensions, grades, capacities, model numbers) and each declares supplier_pool_affecting, which sibling caches key on. Never add an entry per product SKU. IDs in this file are NOT a hardcodable list: consumers must read them through listIntentIds()/listFamilyIds()/listOntologyIds() (or scripts/ontology-ids.mjs) and compare ontology_version, because intents split and any copied list rots silently. This file must stay byte-identical between farqconstraction/src/lib and farq/api/lib/construction.
